notes: Signing up with your phone number: you see your manager's approval within about 10 seconds.
On a rest day, day off or public holiday the button is the purple OT Check-In: it is recorded as overtime and sent to HR.
If your manager removes your phone, the app resets itself: enter your company code to start again.
bsbdemo: managers can see who has opened a message, not only who confirmed it.
